exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions. Use the words in brackets to write sentences with must have and can’t have.

items.cue: 🧥 The jacket you bought is very good quality.
answers: It must have been very expensive.

items.cue: 🏠 I haven’t seen our neighbours for the last few days.

items.prompt: (I / leave / it in the restaurant last night)
answers: I must have left it in the restaurant last night.

items.cue: 💼 Amy was in a very difficult situation when she lost her job.
answers: It can't have been easy for her.

answers: He must have been waiting for somebody.
